title: Unistochastic reduction of multi-matrix coherent-state kernels
summary: We study finite-$N$ coherent-state overlap kernels in multi-matrix BPS sectors of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory. For commuting coherent-state parameters, the kernel is a Laplace transform of the Haar-pushforward measure on the unistochastic set. After quotienting row- and column-shift redundancies, the nontrivial source is an $(N-1)\times(N-1)$ matrix $D$. On the physical $m$-matrix locus, $D$ is a Gram matrix with $\operatorname{rank}D\leq m$, and the ordinary HCIZ sector is precisely the rank-at-most-one stratum.
